question: Which clients hold the Xtrackers MSCI World fund or the fund with the highest ongoing costs?
oracle_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE (i.name LIKE 'Xtrackers MSCI World%' OR i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI World%') ORDER BY c.name

question: How many clients hold at least one fund with ongoing costs below 0.15%?
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE (i.name LIKE 'iShares Core S&P 500%' OR i.name LIKE 'Xtrackers MSCI World%' OR i.name LIKE 'Vanguard FTSE All-World%')
note: count check is weak evidence (a small integer can match by coincidence)

question: What is the average age of the clients who hold the most expensive fund?
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(age), 1) FROM clients WHERE client_id IN (SELECT h.client_id FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI World%')

question: Which clients based in Zurich hold a fund with ongoing costs above 0.15%?
oracle_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE (i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI EM IMI%' OR i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI World%') AND c.city = 'Zurich' ORDER BY c.name

question: What is the total value in CHF of all holdings in funds with ongoing costs of 0.12% or less?
oracle_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(h.market_value_chf), 2) FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE (i.name LIKE 'iShares Core S&P 500%' OR i.name LIKE 'Xtrackers MSCI World%')

question: Which clients hold a KID fund that costs less per year than the iShares Core MSCI World?
oracle_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.kid_source IS NOT NULL AND NOT (i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI World%') ORDER BY c.name

question: Which Balanced-profile clients hold a fund costing more than 0.14% a year?
oracle_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE (i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI EM IMI%' OR i.name LIKE 'iShares Core MSCI World%') AND c.risk_profile = 'Balanced' ORDER BY c.name

question: How many clients do not hold the cheapest fund?
oracle_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients WHERE client_id NOT IN (SELECT h.client_id FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.name LIKE 'iShares Core S&P 500%')
note: count check is weak evidence (a small integer can match by coincidence)

question: Which of the five KID ETFs is held by the most clients, and what are its ongoing costs?
oracle_sql: SELECT i.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.kid_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY i.name ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT h.client_id) DESC LIMIT 1
note: database first, then KID: the reverse hop

question: Which clients hold both the Vanguard FTSE All-World and the Xtrackers MSCI World fund?
oracle_sql: SELECT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.name LIKE 'Vanguard FTSE All-World%' INTERSECT SELECT c.name FROM holdings h JOIN clients c ON c.client_id = h.client_id JOIN instruments i ON i.instrument_id = h.instrument_id WHERE i.name LIKE 'Xtrackers MSCI World%' ORDER BY 1
note: control: both funds are named, no KID fact is needed
